heroes.card.diego.title: Diego
heroes.card.diego.subtitle: Gen 8 · Infantry
heroes.card.diego.summary: Snap. Diego closes his pocket watch. "Fifteen seconds. Very impressive. You are the strongest opponent I have faced lately." The challenger scrambles to his feet and stumbles away, dejected, without once looking back. "I hope he can pull himself together." "He was already the strongest swordsman for a hundred miles around. I can't believe the result was the same." "This guy is an absolute monster. No one has ever lasted twenty seconds against him." ...Diego pays no mind to the nattering of the crowd. He silently sheathes his greatsword and sits in the tavern, waiting for the next challenger to arrive. Perhaps the spirits are too strong today, for Diego falls into a rare, long-lost trance of memory. Even as a child, his tender age cannot hide his staggering talent for the blade. He quickly defeats all peers his age, and his opponents gradually shift from wandering mercenaries to renowned masters. Without exception, he is always the last one standing. He thinks he can keep winning forever, until a boy carrying twin swords appears. This is the strongest opponent he has ever faced; they fight from dawn until dusk without a victor. Finally, the boy is led away by his adoptive father, and Diego does not even have the chance to ask his name. I am much stronger than I was back then. He probably wouldn't be a match for me now. Sometimes Diego thinks this. "I hope not, though. That would be too boring." At times like these, Diego swallows a bitter mouthful of strong liquor. Diego desperately needs a rival. Decades of victory have numbed his competitive heart. Everyone thinks he travels the world to win more, but only Diego knows the truth: he is looking for a defeat. "Barkeep, a drink." Another person enters the tavern. "Are those twin swords...?" "Quiet! That's Amadeus of the Unjust League." "Twin swords?"Diego slowly raises his head. His deadened heart finally beats once more. Unrighteous Strike! Amadeus swings his sword at Diego, only to be blocked by a barrier of sword aura that seems impenetrable. Diego moves like a phantom and quickly closes the distance, met by three fierce waves of energy. He raises his blade to parry, his blunt heavy sword ringing with a resonant clang. Seizing the upper hand, Amadeus brings both swords down in an attempt to crush him, but Diego maintains his focus and retaliates with invisible blades of wind... The terrifying sword pressure radiating from the two combatants keeps the crowd from drawing near. This world-shaking duel ultimately ends in a draw when the military forcefully intervenes, but it is clear that Diego is not yet satisfied. "We will definitely settle this later, Amadeus." "Of course, I'm definitely going to beat you... uh, what's your name again?"

heroes.card.liz.title: Liz
heroes.card.liz.subtitle: Gen 8 · Cavalry
heroes.card.liz.summary: Lizzy is undeniably a peerless genius. This fact is proven the very first time she steps into a laboratory at the age of ten. Initially, the busy adults in the lab have no time for her; even as the little girl struggles to carry heavy bottles of reagents with both hands, no one pays her any mind. That is, until a massive bubble suddenly appears before their eyes. It is the exact energy storage device they have dreamed of creating for years. They have tested countless reagent combinations without finding a stable formula, yet here this dazzling breakthrough sits, appearing with effortless ease. The mastermind behind it all simply blinks in confusion at the awestruck crowd.Type the story here.. From that day forward, Lizzy spends all her time in the lab. The researchers who once taught her gradually become her assistants as Lizzy easily shatters one scientific barrier after another. Countless powerful mixtures are born from her hands. Driven by Lizzy's concoctions, her kingdom rises to power at an astonishing pace, quickly breaking free from the oppression of other nations. This makes Lizzy feel that her work is full of meaning. But things develop far beyond Lizzy's imagination. After driving out the invaders, the kingdom does not stop. They begin to ruthlessly invade neighboring countries. With the exception of one nation where a prince pilots a mech to successfully resist, every other neighbor falls—and it is all thanks to the enhancement concoctions she created. When the King awards Lizzy the Medal of Merit, she looks out at the audience. The soldiers below, driven into a frenzy by the war, gaze up at her in reverence, while captured enemy troops in the distance glare with bitter resentment. Nearby, ragged residents clap their hands even as they secretly sigh... These complex emotions leave Lizzy, who has lived her life in a lab, feeling completely overwhelmed. On the night after the ceremony, Lizzy's laboratory explodes for unknown reasons. All the research concoctions burn to ash, and Lizzy herself vanishes without a trace, leaving only an honorary medal corroded by reagents. Everyone says she is dead, as no one can survive such an explosion—unless she has a magical bubble that can encase her and absorb energy. Without Lizzy and her alchemical concoctions, the kingdom is forced to halt its invasion, and peace finally returns. People occasionally lament the loss of the genius girl over dinner. The King searches the ruins countless times but finds no surviving research; her traces have completely vanished... Thousands of miles away, a wandering alchemist appears in a Governor's town. The potions she sells are baffling: they make rats run faster, let mosquitoes live three days longer, and make weeds grow over three feet tall. It is said she even has the power to turn stone into gold, but no one has ever seen it. So far, she hasn't sold a single proper potion. "Hey, stay away from that flask, unless you want to turn into a puppy..."

heroes.card.luna.title: Luna
heroes.card.luna.subtitle: Gen 8 · Archer
heroes.card.luna.summary: Legends tell of a mysterious ancient kingdom hidden deep within a forest in the far west. The citizens there worship three sacred artifacts to pray for peace. Each possesses immense power, and claiming even one would be enough to conquer the entire world. Ambitious warlords relentlessly infiltrate the woods in attempts to steal these treasures, but without exception, they are all driven back by a rain of sharp arrows, ultimately returning without success. The artifacts are protected by a Squad known as the Starry Guardian, led by their captain, Luna. Upon coming of age, Luna swears an oath to dedicate her life to defending the sacred treasures. Her obsessive, grueling training makes her the greatest archer in the ancient kingdom. Luna firmly believes that no matter how dire the situation, as long as she has her longbow in hand, she can neutralize any threat. Days of peace never last for long. A toxic arrow suddenly pierces through the darkness, its tip reflecting a glint of starlight that blinded the eye. "Enemy incoming! Watch out!" Even with Luna's prompt warning, her subordinates fall one after another. Luna swiftly draws her bow and fires into the distance. As a speck of cold light vanishes into the endless darkness, a muffled groan echoes back to her ears. Under the cover of night, no one can rival Luna. She quickly rallies her remaining troops for a counterattack, effortlessly wiping out the foes hiding in the shadows. However, the sudden shift in the enemy's strength gives Luna a terrible sense of foreboding. She rushes to where the artifacts are kept, only to catch a glimpse of the enemy's back as they prepare to snatch the final one, the Ancient Guardian. Enraged, Luna launches a furious assault on the mysterious invader. Her relentless barrage forces the thief to momentarily abandon the Ancient Guardian, but she soon realizes that her attacks are completely ineffective. The enemy effortlessly deflects every single one of her arrows. This is the defensive power of another sacred artifact, the Moon Stone. Seeing that her foe is about to escape, Luna locks her eyes on the Ancient Guardian... Releasing a radiant arrow powerful enough to pierce the very heavens, she sends the mysterious enemy crashing heavily to the ground. By drawing upon the artifact's power, Luna finally manages to pin the thief down. Just as Luna closes in to deliver the final blow, a thick cloud of poisonous smoke engulfs them both. Before losing consciousness, the last thing Luna sees is the enemy fleeing into the night with two of the sacred artifacts. The very night vision she once prided herself on now serves only to bear witness to her disgrace. When Luna awakes, she's consumed by overwhelming shame. Her own negligence and arrogance had cost them two invaluable artifacts. Even if the King doesn't punish her, she insists on answering for her failure with her life. "Since you feel that way, then go and recover the artifacts. Consider this a chance to redeem yourself." And so, for the first time in her life, Luna leaves the familiarity of her forest. Armed with the Ancient Guardian, an artifact specially granted to her by the King, she embarks on a journey to recover the artifacts and seek revenge. She swears a solemn oath to drag that mysterious enemy back to the forest to face justice. To gather information, Luna chooses to set up her base of operations in the largest, most powerful Governor's town in the wilderness. "I'll help you out until I recover the artifacts. I definitely won't let my guard down again this time."
